title: Xdrip With Miao Miao 2
symptom: Users ask if Miao Miao 2 works with xDrip using Libre 1. Later reports say the Miao Miao 2 connects in xDrip but no readings are received; the event log shows 'Got null pointer trying to set CCCD descriptor'.
cause: Older xDrip versions had a bug triggering 'Got null pointer trying to set CCCD descriptor' when connecting to Miao Miao 2, which prevented glucose readings.
fix: Update to the latest xDrip version for Miao Miao 2 support (for example the 2019.11.22 release linked by the maintainer); a special test build was also reported to fix the issue.
evidence_quote: Please update to latest xdrip version for the work with MM2.
